description: Technical overview of Colleaf Office Suite: local Daptin runtime, SQLite storage, application capabilities, native file formats, resource limits and personal-pilot deployment status.
headline:
Local office suite.
Single-owner runtime.
intro: Browser UI backed by a local Daptin process, SQLite database and managed files. Includes documents, spreadsheets, file management, calendars, contacts, local mail drafts and booking configuration.
